A nomadic empire, the [nomad_harvesting_deposits_country.GetName], has conducted harvesting operations in the [nomad_harvested_system.GetName] system and is drawing resources from our deposits, rendering them unprofitable for the near future.

This violation of our sovereignty should probably not go unanswered. Should we wish it so, we could muster our fleets to drive the Nomads off and forbid them access to our space.

# 资源被游牧民采收 / Resources Harvested By Nomads

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/nomads_events_1.txt:13109-13185; common/on_actions/02_component_on_actions.txt:223 · DLC: Nomads · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

游牧民在我方星系采收资源时（on_harvest_resources → nomads.4105），若我方是普通非游牧帝国，3年内只通知一次，收到 nomads.4110。

When nomads harvest resources in our space (on_harvest_resources -> nomads.4105), a regular non-nomadic owner is notified at most once per 3 years with nomads.4110.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

通知我方领地内的资源被游牧民采收。

A notice that nomads harvested resources inside our borders.
